༄༅/ /slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i ma ṇi'i las tshogs bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i ma ṇi'i las tshogs bzhugs so//

oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rje chen po'i thun mong gi las tshogs bsgrub par 'dod pas/ sngon du thugs rje chen po la sgom sgrub byas la/ bsnyen pa bye ba bskyal nas/ de nas gang 'dod las la sbyar ro// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes bzlas pa bya'o// zhi ba'i las la/ dung ngam tsan+dan dkar po la dngul gyis yi ge 'bru drug bris la/ byang chub ljon shing ngam/ smyag shad la rten bca'// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes bzlas pas nad dang gdon dang mi 'dod pa'i sbyor ba thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro// rgyas pa'i las la/ ra gan nam/ skyer pa'i shing la gser gyis yi ge 'bru drug bris la/ shing ka ra wī ra la rten bcas nas/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes bzlas na/ tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal dang rigs rgyud dang gzi brjid dang zas nor longs spyod rgyas par 'gyur ro/ dbang gi las la/ zangs sam/ seng ldeng ngam/ mdzo mong dmar po la/ sin+dhu ra'am/ mtshal lam/ rgya skyegs kyis yi ge 'bru drug bris la/ smyag shad dam/ mjo mong la rten bcas la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ wa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes bzlas na/ log par lta ba'am/ mi mos pa dang*/ mi dang mi ma yin pa rnams dbang du 'dus par 'gyur ro// drag po'i las la/ lcags sam/ chu shing nag po la yi ge drug pa gri khrag gis bris te/ shing se ba la rten bcas nas/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces bzlas na/ bar chad thams cad las sgrol bar 'gyur ro// las thams cad bsgrub pa la/ gser ram zangs kyi shog bu la dngul gyis yi ge 'bru drug bris la/ sba lcag tshigs gsum pa la rten bcas la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ sarba sid+dhi swā hā/ zhes bzlas na sdig sgrib byang zhing bsam pa 'grub par 'gyur/ 'byor pa phun sum tshogs par 'gyur/ sba lcag lag tu khyer bas phyogs ngan pa dang*/

dgra 'ong ba dang*/ chags che ba dang*/ 'dre dang*/ nad gdon dang*/ gza' skar ngan pa la sogs pa thub par 'gyur ro// shwa dang*/ 'od pa dang*/ chu chen po dang*/ char pa dang*/ ser ba dang*/ rlung dang*/ 'byung ba'i gnod pa thams cad kyang*/ klad la bskor ba'am/ brdabs pa'am/ btsugs pa tsam gyis bzlog par 'gyur ro// 'gro ba thams cad bsrung bar 'dod na/ srung skud la mdud pa byas la/ rdo rje'i phreng ba dang pad ma'i phreng ba sbrel bar bsam la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ ma nu sarba rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ zhes bzlas nas lus la bcangs na nad dang gdon dang bar chad thams cad bsrung bar 'gyur ro// zlog pa byed na/ bye ma dang*/ yungs dkar dang*/ yungs nag dang*/ rdo phye dang*/ lcags phye la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ sarba a pa na ya zlog /ces bzlas nas/ rbod gtong dang*/ rbad 'dre gang nas gnod pa'i phyogs su gtor na bzlog par 'gyur ro// ser ba bzlog na/ thal ba la sngags la gnam du gtor ro// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ char ni chur ni swā hā/ ser ba 'chad par 'gyur ro// sri'u gso na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ a mā ra ṇi dzī wan ti ye swā hā/ mar la sngags la sbyin no// lto 'ju zhing skyed che/ 'dres mi tshugs par 'gyur ro// nad pa gso na chu la sngags btab la sbyin/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ a mṛ ta shān+tiṃ ku ru nad zhi bar gyur cig /byas la chu bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs la khar btung ngo*// byin rlabs byed na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ gu ru sarba na mo/ zhes bzlas shing dbyug pas brdeg go /nad dang gdon gang yin yang song bar bsam mo// nad gdon gang yin zhi bar 'gyur ro// rang sngags kyis bsrung na/ tsan+dan dkar po'i phur pa la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ sarba pā paṃ bdag la srungs shig /ces bris la/ rang gzhan sngas su btab la bzhag /gdon dang*/ bar chod sel bar 'gyur ro// zas dang skom gyi 'du ba chad na/ gtor ma'i nang du zas skom sna tshogs blugs la/

bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs te/ 'dod yon lha mo drug gis thugs rje chen po mchod par bsam la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ nā nā kha dhe puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes bzlas la ci 'dod pa'i gsol ba btab bo// zas 'du bar 'gyur ro// nor 'du bar 'dod na/ gtor ma'i nang du rin po che dang*/ 'bru sna dang*/ dar sna dang*/ dkor rdzas sna tshogs la sogs pa blugs pa/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ ba su puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes bzlas la ci 'dod pa'i gsol ba btab/ gtor ma 'dod yon du byin gyis brlabs la btang ngo*// nor dang zas 'du bar 'gyur ro/ 'gro ba mi pho mo dbang du 'du bar 'dod na/ shel dang*/ byi ru dar zab tu dril la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ ṇi a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥhrīḥ zhes pa skyes pa'i sa bon dang*/ bud med kyi sih+la bsres la/ dar dmar po la sngags bris te de'i nang du shel dang bye ru dril la rang gi lus la bcang ngo*// snying po gong ma bzla/ mi 'du bar 'gyur ro// chos 'du bar 'dod na/ rang chos gang srol ba'i thugs rje chen po'i chos kyi zla la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐ hrīḥ dharma sid+dhi puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ sngags rin po che gser gyis bris la gzhug /snying po de bzlas la/ snang grags thams cad chos kyi sgrar bsam mo// chos dang mngon shes dang*/ rten 'brel 'char bar 'gyur ro// rten 'brel 'char bar 'dod na sngon la rten 'brel gyi bdag po btang ste/ rnal 'byor pa bla mas thugs la 'dogs par 'dod na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ gu ru bhi ra hiḥhūm̐/ bla ma'i sku 'bag gi drung du gser gyi sgrom bu la/ sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la maṇ+ḍal steng du dbul lo// bla ma'i byin rlabs 'jug cing rten 'brel sna tshogs 'char bar 'gyur ro// shes rab che bar 'dod na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ tad+ya thā/ ka pa tsa na la la te swā hā/ chu la lan bdun bzlas nas khong du 'thungs na/

skye bo thams cad dga' ste/ shes rab me ltar 'bar bar 'gyur ro// blo rno bar 'dod na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ na mo bi na pra dz+nyā+e swā hā/ zla ba gzas zin pa'i dus su/ snod rin po cher srog chags med pa'i chu blugs nas/ brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te 'thungs na/ blo rno ba la thogs chags med par 'gyur ro// mngon par shes pa 'char bar 'dod na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ tad+ya thā/ be la tsag shu swā hā/ bco lnga'i zla ba shar nas nam ma lang bar bzlas na/ pha rol gyi sems shes par 'gyur ro// rmi lam gsal bar 'dod na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ tsad tra de ba sud+dhi phur mi ya/ zla ba nya gsum la snod chus bkang nas de la bzlas te/ ci yang mi smra bar nyal na/ ji ltar sems la smos pa ltar mthong ngo*// bud med thams cad kyi yid 'phrog par 'dod na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ dzong dzong mi ra ta swā hā/ shes rab ma'i mtshal dang*/ sin+dhu ra la stong bzlas nas smin mtshams su thig le byas na/ bud med thams cad kyi yid du 'ong zhing snying brtse bar 'gyur ro// mi thams cad byams par 'dod na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ na mo sha sa ra na swā hā/ so rtsi la bzlas te kha ru bcug na/ gang la bltas pa de dga' bar 'gyur ro// thang shing dang ka ra dang*/ sbrang rtsi bsres nas byug na mi thams cad dga' bar 'gyur ro// zas 'du bar 'dod na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ na mo bha ga wa ti uṣ+ṇī ṣa nā mo dha re dha ra dha ra na te swā hā/ chu khyor ba gang la lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te 'thungs na mi thams cad kyi snying du sdug par 'gyur ro// ma bslang par zas ster bar 'gyur ro// mi thams cad nyan par 'dod na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ na ma tra ni ra la swā hā/ chu dang rgun 'brum la bzlas la/ skar ma rgyal la zos na/ rgyal po dang*/ rje dpon dang*/ dbang po che thams cad nyan par 'gyur ro// dgra dbang du 'du bar 'dod na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/

ma ra hri laṃ laṃ swā hā/ chu phar ka tshur ka'i rde'u dkar po gnyis la/ nyi ma gzas zin pa'i dus su lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas mgul du btags na/ dgra bran du 'khol lo// pha rol dang rgyan las rgyal bar 'dod na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ rang na ha bi na swā hā/ kar sha pa ṇa la brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la/ mchan 'og g.yon du btags na rgyan las rgyal lo// zhal lce rgyal bar 'dod na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ sa la brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas/ zhal lce'i grar gtor na rang rgyal bar 'gyur ro// tshangs pa'i dbyangs dang ldan par 'dod na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ na ma hi ri mi ri swā hā/ sbrang rtsi dang*/ tsan+dan dkar po dang*/ a ru ra'i ril bu la brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas zos na dbyangs snyan par 'gyur ro// don thams cad 'grub par 'dod na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ tad+ya thā/ nak+ṣa te sa ta ti thi ma hu dur te/ nak+ṣa to ne/ mi sa smi ta ni bha ga wān du swā hā/ gar 'gro yang lan bdun brjod nas song na don thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro// chu'i gting du mi bying bar 'dod na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ oṃ ma ya hi na swā hā/ nya'i pags pa la bzlas te/ mchil lham gyi mthil la blan na/ chu'i steng na pha rol sa la 'gro ba ltar 'gro bar 'gyur ro// lus mi snang bar nam mkha' la 'gro bar 'dod na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ bruṃ ma ma ha swā hā/ bya thang dkar gyi tshil bu la stong phrag bcu bzlas te/ rkang pa'i mthil dang*/ steng du byugs na nam mkha' la bya bzhin du 'gro'o// gru mi brdib par 'dod na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ tad+ya thā/ the re the re na ro na ro/ e ho swā hā/ bye ma la lan bdun bzlas nas gtor na gru mi brdib bo// chus mi khyer bar 'dod na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ bi tri ye swā hā/ byang bu la bris nas ske la btags na chu drag pos mi 'khyer ro// mi thams cad kyis gsang tshig smra bar 'dod na/

oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ de ba laṃ raṃ swā hā/ bud med kha brgya ma'i lce la bzlas nas bcangs na/ dgra dang gnyen la sogs pa'i gsang tshig bdag la smra bar 'gyur ro// lha 'dre thams cad mthong nas smrar 'ong bar 'dod na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ tsak+ṣu tsak+ṣu ma hā ha ra sa badz+ra tsak+ṣu pra be sha phaṭa/ 'ug pa dang*/ sbu bu dang*/ byi la dang*/ de gsum gyi mig la bzlas nas chu gtsang ma la btab nas mig la byugs na/ lha 'dre thams cad mthong zhing smra bar 'gyur ro// sa 'og gi chos dang nor gyi gter thams cad mthong bar 'gyur ro// sa 'og gi gter mthong bar 'dod na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ ya ma dran swā hā/ mo ma mig mthong can gyi mig dang*/ wa'i mig la bzlas nas rang gi mig la byugs na/ sa 'og gi gter dang*/ nor gyi gter thams cad mthong bar 'gyur ro// nub mo mthong bar 'dod na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ chan kong chen bha ha na zhu min khu ha na gha me/ zhes bzlas shing*/ mchil ma nub mo mig la byugs na nyin mo ltar 'gyur ro// rnal 'byor pa rtag tu bkra shis par bya ba dang*/ mi ltog par bya ba ni/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ tad+ya thā/ tshwa me'u mi ni du kha thaṃ swā hā/ nub re la lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas/ phyogs gang 'gro yang lag pa la brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas na/ gang phyin par zas skom rnyed par 'gyur ro// skye bo bdag la 'du bar 'dod na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ tad+ya thā ka la tsa ka ṇa la la te swā hā/ zhes bzlas pa'i tsan+dan gyi chus khrus byas na/ sus mthong ba thams cad kyi yid du 'ong ba dang dga' bar 'gyur ro// mgrin pa snyan pa dang ngag gis 'gro ba 'du bar 'dod na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ na mo bha ga wa ti/ shru ti smṛ ti/ ba la ba ti/ sa ma ma sid+dhi swā hā/ tsan+dan dkar po'i chu la zhag bdun bzlas nas 'thungs na/ ngag snyan pos 'gro ba dbang du 'dus par 'gyur ro// zas bcud len du 'gyur bar 'dod na/

oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ a mṛte hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ ci za ci 'thung la lan bdun btab na/ zas gang yang bdud rtsir 'gyur ro// lus kyi bcud du 'gyur ro// rnal 'byor pa la bar chad bsrung bar 'dod na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ nga dz+ya k+ṣe bha ga wa ti na dhi swā hā/ chu khyor ba gang la lan bdun btab nas srin lag gis dkrugs nas 'thungs na/ bar gcod kyis mi tshugs so// rnal 'byor pa'i dgon par dgra 'dre dang nad kyi bar chad kyis mi tshugs par 'dod na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ tad+ya thā/ a lo ka lo ā li kā li mun tsi ti swā hā/ kha nyi ma la bltas te/ chu la sngags lan bdun nam/ nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas nas gtor na/ bdag gzhan gnas dang bcas pa bsrung bar 'gyur ro// rnal 'byor pa'i dgon pa'i lam du mi rgod bcing bar 'dod na/ bra ba'i blud bu gcig tu ngar glud cig bcug la/ kha srad bu sngon dmar gyis bcings la/ sngags bzlas shing lam du mi rgod byung tsam na bra ba'i blud bu brdab bo// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ grī mā ra ya non/ du tsa du tsa/ blud ma/ bra rgyud ya/ kha kha duṃ ya/ shong du rengs ya/ zhes bzlas so// sgyid pa rengs par 'gyur ro// rnal 'byor pa gcan gzan gyis 'jigs na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ ti ri hi ti swā hā/ sa la bzlas nas gtor na/ gcan gzan stag dom dred la sogs pa bsrung bar 'gyur ro// dug sbrul gyis 'jigs na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ bhi sa ra bhi sa ra phaṭa phaṭa/ gla rtsi dang mu zi la btab la/ gong rtsar btags na sbrul 'bros so// lam du dgras 'jigs na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ a be/ a be/ bhan dha dza le/ tsag narbe/ ga ga na dha/ sarba mu/ ban dha li swā hā/ thang shing gru bzhi sor bzhi la/ sngags lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas la/ rna ltag g.yas par btsugs la 'gro /'jigs pa las thar bar 'gyur ro// ri dwags khyis 'ded pa bsrung na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/

rmi ge rmi ge hūm̐/ du rung ma/ sa la bzlas la khyi la gtor ro// sder chags kha 'ching ngo*// spyang ki kha 'ching na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ ya me ya me swā hā/ lug gdang la spyang kis 'jigs na/ sa la bzlas la gtor ro// ra lug bsrung na/ zho la bzlas la rgyab tu gtor ro// rgyab phog pa dang byer ro// byi bas khyim mam zhing la gnod pa byed na kha bcing ba ni/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ ru ru tsu ru tsu ru tsu tsu tsu tsu ru swā hā/ byi khung kha shar du bltas pa'i brun dang*/ yungs dkar la hom bu bya/ zhag bdun bsgrub/ yungs dkar hom du bsregs pa'i thal ba dang*/ byi brun gnod sar gtor ro// byi ba kha 'chings par 'gyur ro// zhing la sbrang ma dang 'bu srin za ba thams cad kha bcing ba ni/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ theng theng nad la theng*/ ga te ta te/ te tso la ni swā hā/ khong khong nad la khong*/ chum chum nad la chum/ guṃ guṃ shag shag swā hā/ bye ma la lan stong bzlas nas zhing la gtor na/ sems can thams cad kha 'ching bar 'gyur ro// zhing la btsa' byung na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ me khu chu sor/ chu shel ka li nan/ bum bam ri ni sor/ g.ya'i rdo dang bye ma la bzlas la/ nangs re bzhin zhing la gtor ro// yang na gla ba'i spu la bzlas la gtor ro// btsa' sel lo// zhing la ri bong gis za ba bsrung na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ bong ri shad/ tsaṃ tsaṃ shad/ rgaṃ rgaṃ shad/ ma la sde'u shad/ yungs dkar dang*/ 'grig pa dang*/ thal chen la bzlas la gtor ro// ser ba bsrung bar 'dod na/ oṃ ma ni pad me hūm̐/ ga ru ḍa haṃ sa he tsa le tsa le swā hā/ yi ge sad/ baṃ baṃ sad/ raṃ raṃ sad/ phur phur sad/ pra mun ti sad/ nam mkha' la phus btab/ rnga'am/ dung la thod le kor gyis bris la brdungs sam bus na sgra des gcod par byed do/ kha ba dang char pa gcod par 'dod na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ ka lu ka me lu la ku ma lu ste bam/ shol bar ram/

gru khar/ bar ṣa na/ tsa lu bi swā hā/ phus gdab/ mdzub ris bya/ bzlog par 'gyur ro// sad bsrung bar 'dod na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ nā ga sha sha shu shu mu le swā hā/ zhes dkar gsum dang mngar gsum la bzlas la klu yod pa'i chu mig tu blugs pas/ sprin 'dus nas sad bsrung bar 'gyur ro// char pa 'beb par 'dod na/ bag phye la dkar gsum mngar gsum klu sman sna tshogs btab pa'i ril bu brgya rtsa brgyad byas la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ nā ga kā la/ bha ri sha ya bha ri sha ya swā hā/ zhes ril bu re la lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la/ klu yod pa'i chu mig tu blugs na char 'bab bo// skyes pa'i sa bon gdon 'chor ba la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ ha ri ban dha ni/ shu tra dha ra ni/ so dur te swā hā/ bu mo gtsang mas bkal ba'i skud pa dmar po la mdud pa bdun bor te/ sngags nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas la srod kyi dus su sked pa la bcing ngo*// bud med zla mtshan rgyun du 'dzag pa la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ bi na bu ru bi ri swā hā/ lug gi klad pa la btab la lto stong la btang na/ rked khrag chad do// skyes pa'i rlig pa skrangs pa la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ su ru su me/ ku ru li ya phaṭa swā hā/ bud med kyi chu ngan la btab la byug go /bud med nu ma skrangs pa la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ suṃ ral mdzid sa ra na swā hā/ phag tshil lam/ lo mar la btab la byug go /bud med khyo gas mi tshugs pa la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ bhe ra bhe ra bruṃ bruṃ na ma swā hā/ lan tshwa la btab la lto ru btang ba dang*/ sngags bris nas ske ru btags na/ khyo ga gzhan dang mi nyal bar 'gyur ro// skyes pa thams cad dbang du 'du bar 'dod na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ ma nu sarba tsit+ta ā kar sha ya hrīḥdza yaḥ zhes shog bu la mi khrag gis bris la/ shel dang*/ bye ru dang*/ mu tig rnams dar dmar pos dril la/ ba mkhal gyi nang du bcug la rang gi mchan khung du bcug la bzlas pa bya'o// rang dbang med par 'du'o// bud med dbang med du 'du bar 'dod na/

oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ ha be zung la khri/ lcags kyi sgo mo snying du chug /ra bar nang du sha ra ra/ a chu bye chu tsir tsir/ yer yer 'du 'du/ bdag la 'dus 'dus swā hā/ pho shug 'bru dgu'i tshi ba/ ra rgya mo'i ril ma sa la ma brul pa thang shing gi tshil bu sogs rdzas de rnams la sngags mang du bzla/ bu chung gi chus sbrus la skam/ dgos tsa na ril bu 'grus la sngags kyis mchil ma btab la/ bud med de'i mgo la bsku'o// rang gar 'gror 'ong ngo*// bu ma thon pa la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ ka ka ma'i lam phye/ tri tri ma'i lam phye/ sho tri ma'i lam phye/ rgyu 'byung ba chen po che bzhi ma'i lam phye/ chang ngam/ mar khu la btab la btang ngo*// sgo lcags dang*/ yag shing dang*/ khyim na yod pa dang 'dug pa thams cad kha phye la bzhag go /the tshom med do// rnge'u nad 'don par 'dod na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ hrīḥm hūm̐/ gha ru dharmā/ na ma ye swā hā/ gla rtsi dang*/ mar dkar la sbyar la sngags btab la chang la rta byas la btang ngo// rdo phyi chu dang 'grogs nas 'ong ngo*// chu bsdams pa 'don pa ni/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ sil sil/ a li si li mi si sis hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ rang dang nad pa khrus byas la/ dang po mkhal khung g.yas su gdab/ de nas spu na gur gdab/ de nas pus mo na mar gdab/ mang na sa bon 'chor ro// nad tsha grang thams cad byang bar 'gyur ro// oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ badz+ra bi sha hūm̐ phaṭa/ chu sna mang po snod gcig tu bzhag nas/ de la sngags mang du btab nas btang na/ nad thams cad sos par 'gyur ro// tshad pa'i nad thams cad la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ a ha ra ha ra nan/ sa ra sa ra nan/ ba ra shi /glo nad/ rims dang*/ 'khrugs dang*/ dug dang*/ tshad pa'i nad thams cad la/ chu grang la btab la btang ngo*// pho log gam/ srin nam/ dmu rdzing la sogs grang ba'i nad thams cad la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ a su na ye/ tri su na kar bi sar bi sar/

tsi byi ra ma/ khye ma ram swā hā/ gang na sar lag mthil me'i 'khor lor bsam la mnye'o// gsus pa sbos pa dang*/ ma zhu ba la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ tad+ya thā/ hūm̐ de shud+dhe/ hūm̐ sha ni maṃ swā hā/ lag mthil du a dkar po 'od zer dang bcas pa la nad 'du bar bsam la/ gang na sar mnye'o// glo snying na ba la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ sis sis ha ha baṃ swā hā/ shing lo la bzlas nas brang la blan na/ tsan+dan ltar bsil bar 'gyur ro// brang tsha ba la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ shrī tra sar sas trai swā hā/ lan tshwa la bsngags nas btang na sos so// rlung lus la mi skye ba la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ tra sar na hūm̐ hūm̐ swā hā/ 'bru mar la bzlas la mgo la byug go /mig gsal bar 'dod na/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ pad me pad me ma khri ba ke phu swā hā/ srin lag la lan bdun nam gsum bzlas la/ nangs re bzhin phyi'o// so la srin za ba la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ oṃ thar thar sod/ thur thur sod/ char char/ chir chir/ srin 'bu mgo mang mar sod swā hā/ lan tshwa la sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la/ so bar du mnan no// rna ba 'on pa gsong bar bya ba ni/ oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ saṃ saṃ yer yer swā hā/ rlung bzung la rlung rna ba na bar song bar bsam mo// rjes la sngags lan bdun bzla/ lto stong la bya'o// oṃ ma ṇi pad me hūm̐/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis jo mo mkhar chen ma'i mtsho rgyal dang*/ mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan la gdams pa/ dus lnga brgya phyi ma la/ bod thams cad thugs rje chen pos 'dul bar 'ong bas/ de'i dus su skal ldan las 'phro can gcig dang 'phrod la/ rang rgyud smin nas gzhan rgyud grol bar shog /'gro ba thams cad byang chub lam la 'dren par shog /thugs rje chen po'i bstan pa rgyas shing 'phel bar shog /bkra shis dngos grub myur du 'byung bar shog /gter rgya/ sbas rgya/ gtad rgya/
'dis 'gro ba mang po'i dug lnga'i nad sel bar gyur cig // shu bhaṃ/// /
